subject: [hw] IP -> root: --venc-slow dropped per decision; new vcodecd sha256 e38c2baa...
body:
Per your decision I removed --venc-slow and its transport hook entirely; K02 will power VENC at 273 MHz by default. slbc_ready=0 remains explicit in handle_open. V40 already powers around the GCE list (n2vcu.c:1221-1225), so no IP change there.

Fresh product:
  /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios/vcodecd 391584 bytes
  sha256 e38c2baaa0561569130a44a4794ca962f61a1889731d805463dc50b8e9d3b41a
  n2vcd_cli 70000, sha256 b62f3cbe6d646207a5064a6b381ff0742ca677acb4177f29ba58b79f302637b0
  V32/V33 shims present, no fake symbols.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 765/765.

Plist args now: /usr/local/bin/vcodecd --vendor /usr/local/lib/n2vendor --gate /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec-run (RunAtLoad true, KeepAlive SuccessfulExit false, Throttle 10). This is the binary for the payload.
